title: set_capabilities
description: Switch capabilities off (POST /api/system/set-capabilities, and re-sent when the agent reports a capability on that an administrator switched off). Fail-safe: agents apply only `false`; a `true` is ignored (switching on again needs a local reinstall or repair). The agent answers with `capabilities`.

vision_enabled.description: false = refuse previews, streams and remote input; a running stream stops.
